description: This Dart source file defines the CoursesProvider class, which manages the loading and provision of course summaries, utilizing mock data when configured. It also defines the CourseSummary data model used to represent individual courses in listings.

classes.name: CourseSummary
classes.description: A lightweight model for course summaries used in listings, including fields like id, title, teacher, lessons count, and rating.

classes.name: CoursesProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier class that manages the list of course summaries, supports loading data either from mock services or (commented out) from an API, and notifies listeners on data changes.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Asynchronously loads course data, using mock service if EnvConfig.useMocks is true; manages loading state and notifies listeners accordingly.
